key: Intruders? What would you need here?
en: Intruders? What would you need here?
ja: 侵入者だと? ここに　何の用だ?

key: Tsk. Get out of our faces.
en: Tsk. Get out of our faces.
ja: ちっ。目の前から　失せろ

key: You're on thin ice, you know?
en: You're on thin ice, you know?
ja: あぶない橋を　渡ってるって　自覚は　あるのか?
オレの　視界から　消えろ
出ていけと　言っただろ!

key: Just what do you want with our bombs?
en: Just what do you want with our bombs?
ja: オレたちの　爆薬に　何の用だ?

key: You're going to kill us all, aren't you.
en: You're going to kill us all, aren't you.
ja: おまえ　オレたち全員を　殺す気だな

key: You want these? Come and get them.
en: You want these? Come and get them.
ja: これが　ほしいのか? だったら　奪ってみせろ
ボスが　黙っちゃいないぞ

key: FERN: Good. I'll grab these, let's get out of here.
en: FERN: Good. I'll grab these, let's get out of here.
ja: ファーン: よし。これは　オレ様が　いただく。さっさと　ずらかるぞ
ファーンは　爆薬を　拾い上げた!
